blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.
blocks.zh: 实时视频生成,交互式世界模型,以及在线设备图像合成几乎是一个现实. 扩散变压器(DiT)实现了优异的样品质量,把瓶颈转移到模型本身的吞吐量上. 自然图像本来就是稀少的,因为一幅图像的很大一部分往往是背景,对场景内容贡献不大,很容易被揭穿. DiTs未能利用这种垃圾,因为它们会静态和统一地处理图像符号. 我们提出MoDDiT,一种简单的架构修改,通过MLP和自觉操作学习路由符号. 通过独立通过两个块的路由符,MODDIT允许在MLP中进行动态计算分配,这些分配在符号,图像,以及去诺定时步上都有所不同. 使用MODDIT从零开始训练图像生成模型,大大减少了培训和推论的计算成本,处理的代币只有12.5%. 通过增加垃圾和模型深度,MODDIT减少了成本,并改进了非常规基线的生成性能. 所学的分布是可解释的,揭示了在视觉内容和噪音水平上计算的不同. 我们还使用MODDIT来训练视频生成模型, 分配与运动相关,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advancements in real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis promise numerous new applications for generative models, and a new frontier of synthetic data.
Diffusion models are at the forefront of this progress but are bottlenecked by their iterative generation procedure, which requires multiple model evaluations to generate samples.
The resulting latency is often reduced by distilling models into smaller students or subsampling diffusion timesteps.
A complementary axis of improvement is given by architecture modifications that reduce the cost of each inference step of the denoising process.
blocks.zh:
近期在实时视频生成、互动世界模型和在线设备图像合成方面的进步,为基因模型的众多新应用以及合成数据的新前沿提供了前景。
传播模型处于这一进展的前沿,但被其迭代生成程序所瓶颈,这需要多个模型评价来生成样本.
由此产生的延缓常被通过将模型分馏入较小的学生或分样扩散时间步来降低.
改进的一个互补轴是通过结构修改来实现的,这些修改降低了去名过程每个推断步骤的成本.

blocks.en:
A promising route is exploiting sparsity, inspired by the observation that images and videos are information-sparse modalities where few patches per frame contain a large amount of information.
For example, in many images the background is much simpler than the foreground and is therefore easier to denoise.
This effect is magnified in videos, where patches containing static objects can be simply copied over from the previous frame.
Ideally, diffusion would focus computation on more relevant patches, reducing overall latency.
However, predominant diffusion architectures such as diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 , DiT,) fail to exploit this property, instead applying all operations to every token, thereby allocating compute uniformly over images and videos.
blocks.zh:
一个很有希望的路线是利用垃圾邮件,其灵感来自一种观察,即图像和视频是信息分享模式,每个帧的补丁很少包含大量信息。
例如,在许多图像中,背景比前景简单得多,因此更容易被揭穿.
这种效果在视频中被放大,其中包含静态对象的补丁可以简单地从上个帧复制.
理想的情况是,传播将侧重于更相关的补丁,从而减少总体延迟。
然而,主要的扩散架构,如扩散变压器(Peebles and Xie, 2023, DiT,)未能利用这种属性,而是将所有操作应用到每个符上,从而将计算统一于图像和视频上.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce MoDDiT , a simple mechanism for routing tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations ( section 3 ).
While routing through self-attention uses fixed capacity, routing through MLPs enables dynamic compute allocation across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps ( section 3.2 ).
This allows the model to devote more computation to regions that are visually complex and difficult to denoise.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了MoDDIT,这是一个通过MLP和自留心操作(第3节)的路由符的简单机制.
虽然通过自意的路由使用固定容量,而通过MLP的路由则能够进行动态计算,在信使,图像之间分配并去诺定时步(第3.2节.
这使得模型能够将更多的计算投入到视觉复杂且难以暴露的区域.

blocks.en:
Unlike prior methods, MoDDiT reduces FLOPs during both training and inference, requires no auxiliary routing loss or post-processing, and enables efficient training on parallel GPU hardware without ragged batches.
As illustrated in fig. 1 , the resulting allocation is interpretable, with computation varying across image regions, samples, and denoising timesteps.

如图所显示. 1,由此得出的分配可被解释,计算因图像区域,样本,去诺时间步而异.

blocks.en:
We evaluate MoDDiT across three settings: image generation, video generation, and video distillation.
On ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) ( section 4 ), MoDDiT improves the quality–compute tradeoff over vanilla DiT across a range of routing capacities and sampling lengths.
For video generation, we evaluate on the 1X World Modeling Challenge ( 1X, 2025 ) ( section 5 ), where routing at 12.5% capacity improves video-prediction PSNR while requiring 36.92% fewer counted denoiser FLOPs on the profiled clip than the DiT baseline.
Finally, we integrate sparse feedforward routing into the distillation of pretrained Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , converting a dense bidirectional model into a sparse, few-step autoregressive generator ( section 6 ).
Compared with a matched dense autoregressive student, the sparse model almost matches the dense baseline with a 5 % 5\% overall reduction in score on the VBench benchmark ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , while reducing inference FLOPs by 24 % 24\% .
We further analyze the learned routing behavior ( figs. 4 and 5 ), showing how computation varies with denoising stage, image and patch class, and temporal change in video.
blocks.zh:
我们通过三种方式对MODDIT进行评估:图像生成、视频生成和视频蒸馏。
在ImageNet(Deng等,2009年)(第4节)上,DDIT改进了质量——通过一系列路线能力和取样长度来计算与香草DIT的权衡。
对于视频生成,我们评价了1X世界建模挑战(1X,2025年)(第5节),其中容量为12.5%的路由改善了视频预测PSNR,同时需要比DiT基线少36.92%的可计数字的Denoiser FLOP.
最后,我们把稀有的向前进的路由纳入预训的Wan2.1(Wan等,2025年)的蒸馏中,将稠密的双向模型转换为稀有的几步自递式发电机(第6节).
与相对应的密集自递学生相比,稀有型号几乎与密度基线相匹配,在V Bench基准(Huang等,2023年)上总分下降了5%-5%-%,而推论FLOP则下降了24%-24-%.
我们进一步分析所学的路由行为(图4和图5), 显示计算方式如何随取名阶段、图像和补丁类以及视频的时间变化而变化。

blocks.en:
In summary, MoDDiT provides a simple, efficient mechanism for dynamic token routing, exploiting token-level sparsity in diffusion transformers. By increasing model size and sparsity, it can increase performance while reducing training- and inference-time FLOPs.
We compare routing choices and ablations on ImageNet, and give intuitive explanations for allocation across image content and time steps. On 1X, we test action-conditioned video generation and show that learned allocation varies with temporal change. Distilling Wan2.1 tests whether MoDDiT can be combined with distillation and few-step denoising, where the reduction in inference FLOPs comes with a modest reduction in VBench score.
blocks.zh:
简言之,MODDIT提供了一种简单而高效的动态符号路由机制,在扩散变压器中利用了符号级的垃圾堆. 通过增加模型尺寸和伸缩性,可以提高性能,同时减少培训和推断时间FLOP.
我们比较了ImageNet上的路由选择和模拟,并对图像内容和时间步骤之间的分配给出直观的解释。 在1X上,我们测试了具有动作条件的视频生成,并显示学习到的分配随时间变化而变化. 稀释出Wan2.1测试MoDDIT是否可以与蒸馏和几步去诺结合,其中推论中FLOP的还原值会随着V Bench分数的略微减少而来.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 传播模式

blocks.en:
Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) generate images by iteratively removing noise from samples drawn from a known noisy distribution. Specifically, they consist of two complementary Markov processes: a forward noising process and a reverse denoising process. In the forward process, an initial clean image x 0 x_{0} is progressively corrupted into a purely noisy image x T x_{T} across a discrete sequence of timesteps t = 1 , … , T t=1,\dots,T , following the Gaussian conditional distribution q ⁡ ( x t ∣ x t − 1 ) = 𝒩 ⁡ ( x t , 1 − β t ​ x t − 1 , β t ​ I ) q(x_{t}\mid x_{t-1})=\mathcal{N}(x_{t};\sqrt{1-\beta_{t}}\,x_{t-1},\beta_{t}I) , where β t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \beta_{t}\in(0,1) defines the noise schedule at timestep t t .
Equivalently, this forward process can be expressed as x t = α ¯ t ​ x 0 + 1 − α ¯ t ​ ϵ x_{t}=\sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_{t}}\,x_{0}+\sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_{t}}\,\epsilon , with ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) and α ¯ t = ∏ i = 1 t ( 1 − β i ) \bar{\alpha}_{t}=\prod_{i=1}^{t}(1-\beta_{i}) .
The reverse process, parameterized by a neural network, gradually reconstructs the original clean image from x T x_{T} to x 0 x_{0} by approximating the conditional distributions p θ ​ ( x t − 1 ∣ x t ) = 𝒩 ⁡ ( x t − 1 , μ θ ​ ( x t , t ) , Σ θ ​ ( x t , t ) ) p_{\theta}(x_{t-1}\mid x_{t})=\mathcal{N}(x_{t-1};\mu_{\theta}(x_{t},t),\Sigma_{\theta}(x_{t},t)) .
Model training involves minimizing the discrepancy between the predicted and actual noise at each timestep, enabling accurate modeling of the underlying data distribution.
2.2 Vision- and Diffusion Transformers
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉和传播变形器

blocks.en: Following their success in language modeling, transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) have been successfully applied to vision tasks. Vision transformer ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 , ViT) achieves this by constructing a flattened token sequence from pixel patches. Similar to transformers, ViT models consist of alternating self-attention ( Bahdanau et al., 2014 ) and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) blocks, with intermediate layer normalization ( Ba et al., 2016 ) . In these models, self-attention distributes information across the sample, in this case passing information between image patches, while the MLP processes tokens independently. Diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 , DiT, ) adapt ViT models for image diffusion with adaptive layer normalization (adaLN), which conditions the normalization operation on the diffusion timestep and image class.
blocks.zh: 在成功进行语言建模后,变压器(Vaswani等,2017年)被成功应用于视觉任务. 视觉变压器(Dosovitskiy等,2020年,ViT)通过从像素补丁中构建平分的符号序列来实现这一目标. 与变压器类似,ViT型由交替自留(Bahdanau等,2014年)和多层受体(MLP)块组成,中间层正常化(Ba等,2016年). 在这些模型中,自意在整个样本中分发信息,在此情况下在图像补丁之间传递信息,而MLP则独立地处理信使. 分流变压器(Peebles and Xie, 2023, DiT, )将ViT模型进行图像扩散与适应地层正常化(adaLN)相适应,这为正常化运行提供了扩散时间步和图像类的条件.

blocks.en:
In addition to image generation, DiTs are the predominant architecture for video generation.
Here, bidirectional video models such as Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , which generate entire videos at once without causal constraints, are at the forefront of generation quality.
To accelerate inference and allow for long-horizon generation, they are often finetuned into autoregressive models with fewer denoising steps ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
MoDDiT is independent of, and compatible with these techniques.
blocks.zh:
除了图像生成,DiTs是视频生成的主要架构.
在这里,双向视频模型如Wan2.1(Wan等,2025年),在没有因果限制的情况下一并生成了整个视频,处于生成质量的最前沿.
为了加速推论,并允许长相生成,它们往往被微调为自相递减的模型,去诺步骤较少(Yin等,2025;Huang等,2025;Zhu等,2026).
MODDIT独立于并兼容这些技术.

blocks.en:
Outside of diffusion, various extensions to ViT have been proposed. Darcet et al. (2023) analyse the attention map of ViT models and find attention sinks: low-information image patches with anomalously high attention weights that pool global information. Therefore, the authors propose register tokens with learned embedding values that are appended to the image sequence and discarded at the end of the forward pass.
We extend our models to use register tokens to improve compute allocation, inspired by Darcet et al. (2023) , who demonstrate that removing the attention sinks from the image improves the performance and alignment of saliency maps with semantic features.
blocks.zh:
除推广外,还提议对虚拟技术进行各种扩展。 Darcet等 (2023)分析了ViT模型的注意力图并发现了注意力汇:低信息图像补丁,以异常高的注意力权重集合了全球信息. 因此,作者提出带有已学习到的嵌入值的注册符,附在图像序列后,并被丢弃在前传的末尾.
我们扩展我们的模型,使用寄存符来改进计算分配,灵感来自Darcet等人(2023年),他们证明从图像中去除注意力汇可以提高显著地图的性能和与语义特征相匹配.

blocks.en: 2.3 Mixture-of-Experts Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 专家的混合模型

blocks.en: Mixture-of-experts ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 , MoE,) approaches improve transformer scaling by dividing the transformer’s MLP blocks into multiple expert MLPs, with each token typically routed to only a single expert, as determined by a routing module, a small MLP that computes scalar scores for each token-expert pair. These scores determine the assignment of tokens to experts via (potentially stochastic) top- K K selection.
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-experters (Shazeer等, 2017; Fedus等, 2022, MOE,) 方法通过将变压器的MLP块分割成多位专家MLP来改进变压器的缩放,每个令牌一般只路由一位专家,由一个路由模块确定,一个小MLP为每对令牌-Expertent salar single. 这些分数决定了通过(可能具有斯图克性的)上-K K选择向专家分配符.

blocks.en: While earlier approaches directly optimize stochastic routing decisions to minimize the expected loss using REINFORCE-style objectives ( Bengio et al., 2015 ) , recent work instead uses learned gating functions as the router, using the gate as a heuristic proxy for expert utility ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) . ( Raposo et al., 2024 ) use such a routing mechanism for sparse token processing in language processing, and we propose combining it with dynamic MLP sparsity for image patches.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前采用直接优化花纹路由决定的方法,以利用REINFORCE式目标来将预期损失最小化(Bengio等,2015年),但最近的工作却使用已学到的取景功能作为路由器,将大门作为专家公用事业的热能代用(Shazeer等,2017年). (Raposo等, 2024 )在语言处理中使用这样的通路机制进行稀有的符号处理,我们提议将其与动态的MLP sparersity结合,用于图像补丁.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dynamic Allocation in MLP Routing
blocks.zh: 3.2 MLP路线中的动态分配

blocks.en: MLPs process each token independently, allowing for a simple way to introduce dynamic sparsity.
blocks.zh: MLPs分别独立地处理每个令牌,允许简单的方式引入动态相接.

blocks.en:
During training , instead of selecting the top- K K tokens per sample, we can merge the batch and token dimensions and select the top-( B ⋅ K B\cdot K ) tokens across the whole batch on each GPU ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) .
Since samples in each batch belong to different classes and diffusion steps, the model can learn to dynamically allocate compute based on image class and diffusion step ( section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,我们不选择每个样本的上-K K 令牌,而是可以合并批次和令牌尺寸,并在每个GPU上选择整个批次的上-(B ⋅ K B\cdot K)令牌(Shi等,2025;Yuan等,2025)。
由于每批样本属于不同的类和扩散步骤,该模型可以学习根据图像类和扩散步骤(第4节)动态分配计算.

blocks.en:

Instead, we can approximate the global top- ( B ⋅ K ) (B\cdot K) operation applied during training by tracking a logit threshold T T at training time, such that p ⁡ ( R ϕ ​ ( t i ) ≥ T ) = c p(R_{\phi}(t_{i})\geq T)=c .
Here c = K / N c=K/N is the model capacity, i.e., the targeted fraction of tokens we route on average.

blocks.en: 3.3 Fixed-Capacity Routing for Self-Attention
blocks.zh: 3.3 自我维持的固定能力路线

blocks.en:
In self-attention, the number of tokens in an example determines the dimensions of its attention matrix.
For efficient parallel processing on GPUs, all examples in the same batch must use attention matrices with the same dimensions.
Therefore, we cannot simply give each example a different number of tokens, because this would produce differently sized matrices and prevent efficient vectorized computation.
We subsequently route a fixed number of K K tokens for each example.
blocks.zh:
在自我关注中,一个例子中的符号数量决定了它的注意力矩阵的维度.
为了高效地在GPU上平行处理,同批中的所有实例必须使用同维度的注意矩阵.
因此,我们不能简单地给每个例子一个不同的代号,因为这将产生不同大小的矩阵,并防止有效的矢量计算。
我们随后为每个实例传送一个 K 符号的固定编号 。

blocks.en:

This opens up a design space for routing context (keys and values) and output (queries) independently, or routing based on relevance as context.
We elaborate and show results for possible setups in section A.3.1 , and find that the simple method in section 3.1 is among the best, so we select it for its simplicity.

This includes using the same pre-trained variational autoencoder ( Kingma et al., 2013 , VAE) from Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , with an 8 × 8\times downsample factor.
To make MoDDiT comparable in FLOPs with DiT, we construct MoDDiT by replacing alternate DiT blocks with two MoDDiT blocks, approximately matching DiT FLOPs for a 50% capacity model with the same configuration. For more details, see section A.1 .

We found that decreasing capacity throughout the model’s blocks helped preserve both global structure and fine details; see section C.1 .
We train two models, Funnel50 and Funnel20, which respectively decrease each block’s capacity from 100% to 50% and 20%.
Both models use sparse attention and MLP routing.
To control stochastic exploration, we adapt the routing-noise temperature to attain a target replacement rate within the top- K K .
The student weights and routers are jointly optimized.
We gradually introduce sparsity during adaptation and use straight-through router gates to preserve the scale of pretrained updates.
Training uses AdamW with gradient accumulation to obtain an effective batch size of 64.

blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Transformers have become the predominant architecture for flow-based generative modeling, in both image generation with models such as DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , DALL-E 3 ( Goh et al., 2023 ) , and Latte ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , as well as video generation in GAIA-2 ( Russell et al., 2025 ) , Genie 2 ( Parker-Holder et al., 2024 ) , Mochi ( GenmoAI, 2024 ) , Sora ( Brooks et al., 2024 ) , MovieGen ( Polyak et al., 2024 ) , and Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . This paradigm naturally invites adaptive compute allocation, since denoising difficulty varies across noise levels and spatio-temporal regions. Furthermore, many of the downstream applications of these models, such as large-scale image generation and real-time video generation, have strict constraints on latency that require fast inference. Despite this, adaptive computation techniques have not yet been adopted in state-of-the-art models.

However, interest in this research area has recently increased. Wang et al. (2024) learn sparsity masks for pre-trained diffusion models without content-dependent selection, while Xi et al. (2025) use online profiling to sparsify spatial-temporal attention connections while retaining all tokens.
Token compression methods reduce the sequence length through token merging in ToMeSD ( Bolya and Hoffman, 2023 ) .
ToCa ( Zou et al., 2025 ) and RAS ( Liu et al., 2026 ) reuse computation across denoising timesteps through cached token features and noise predictions for inactive regions, respectively.
DiffCR ( You et al., 2025 ) routes tokens through or around whole transformer blocks and learns layer- and timestep-specific capacities with an auxiliary budget loss, evaluated by fine-tuning pretrained diffusion models.

然而,最近对这一研究领域的兴趣已经增加。 王等编. (2024年)在不依赖内容选择的情况下,为训练有素的传播模型学习垃圾口罩,而习近平等. (2025年)使用在线剖面分析在保留所有符符的同时将空间-时态的注意力连接化.
Token压缩方法通过在ToMeSD(Bolya and Hoffman, 2023)中的符号合并来减少序列长度. .
ToCa(Zou等人,2025年)和RAS(Liu等人,2026年)通过缓存的代号特征和对不活动区域的噪音预测,跨越去Noing时间步进行再利用计算。
DiffCR(您等,2025年) 通向整个变压器块或周围的路标,并学习有辅助预算损失的分层和分时段特定能力,通过微调预受训练的放电模型进行评估.

blocks.en:
More closely related, DyDiT ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and DyDiT++ ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) combine timestep-conditioned width reduction with content-dependent token bypass in MLP blocks, using an auxiliary loss to control overall FLOPs.
They require full self-attention during training, so sparsity is only introduced in inference.
TREAD ( Krause et al., 2025 ) accelerates training by randomly selecting tokens to bypass sequences of transformer blocks, while retaining dense computation at inference.
Our method learns separate token routers for attention and MLP blocks jointly with the diffusion model from scratch, without auxiliary losses, while preserving tensor shapes for efficient batch inference with per-sample flexibility in the MLP blocks.
blocks.zh:
更紧密的联系, 数字 (赵等,2025)和DyDIT++. (Zhao等,2026)在MLP区块中将分时阶的宽度减小与依赖内容的符号绕行相结合,使用辅助损失来控制整体FLOP.
他们在训练时需要完全的自觉,因此斯帕克特只是引入了推论.
TREAD(Krause等,2025年)通过随机选择符号来绕过变压器块的序列来加速训练,同时在推断时保留了密集的计算.
我们的方法从零开始与扩散模型一起学习注意和MLP区块的单独的符号路由器,没有附带损失,同时在MLP区块中为高效的批量推论保留了收音机外形并具有每个样本的灵活性.

blocks.en:
Mixture-of-experts mechanisms ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 , MoE) allocate computation by routing tokens among multiple MLP experts, as in EC-DiT ( Sun et al., 2025 ) .
DiffMoE ( Shi et al., 2025 ) pools tokens across examples and learns a capacity predictor for adaptive inference; Expert Race ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) combines global token–expert competition with tracked-threshold inference.
MoDDiT shares these allocation principles but applies them to a single MLP branch, combines them with independently routed sparse attention, and trains the model from scratch without a separately supervised capacity predictor or auxiliary routing objectives.
blocks.zh:
专家混合机制(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年;教育部)通过路由符号在多位MLP专家中分配计算,如EC-DIT(Sun等人,2025年).
DiffMoE(Shi等,2025年)汇集了各种实例,并学习了适应性推论的能力预测器; Expert Race(Yuan等,2025年)将全球信使-专家竞争与跟踪门槛推论相结合。
MODDIT分享了这些分配原则,但将其应用于一个单一的MLP分支,将其与独立的路由稀疏的注意力结合起来,并且从零开始训练模型,没有单独的受监督的能力预测器或辅助路由目标.

blocks.en:
Outside of diffusion modeling, adaptive computation has become increasingly prevalent in transformer models, in order to allocate resources efficiently based on input complexity. Xin et al. (2020) propose a language model architecture with adaptive depth via an early exiting mechanism.
Inspiring this work, mixture-of-depths ( Raposo et al., 2024 ) uses a routing mechanism to limit the capacity of transformer layers in autoregressive language models. While this method shows improvements in the FLOPs-normalized performance frontier of such models, we find diffusion to be an even more suitable paradigm for this architecture, as the models avoid causal structure interfering with the top- K K operation.
blocks.zh:
除了推广模型外,适应性计算在变压器模型中已越来越普遍,以便根据投入的复杂性有效地分配资源。  等. (2020年)通过早期退出机制提出具有适应深度的语言模型架构.
激发了这项工作的灵感,"相通"(Raposo等,2024年)采用通向机制来限制自相递变相语言模型中变相器层的能力. 虽然这种方法显示了这种模型的FLOPs-常态化性能前沿的改进,但我们发现扩散对于这种架构来说是一个更合适的范式,因为模型避免了因果结构干扰上-K K操作.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: MoDDiT represents a significant advancement in efficient generative modeling, effectively addressing a computational inefficiency inherent in existing diffusion models by dynamically allocating compute across tokens, samples, and noise levels. By employing a minimal yet powerful routing mechanism, MoDDiT demonstrates considerable performance improvements at the same level of compute, on both image and video generation tasks. Our evaluation also provides an intuitive understanding of the learned routing mechanism, highlighting MoDDiT’s capability to align computational effort with semantic importance and temporal dynamics. Our work thus provides a step towards unlocking generative modeling in latency- and hardware-constrained settings and offers insights into the distribution of computational resources within diffusion models.
blocks.zh: MODDIT是高效基因模型的显著进展,通过动态地分配符号、样本和噪音水平之间的计算,有效地解决了现有传播模型固有的计算效率低下的问题。 通过使用最小但强大的路由机制,MODDIT在图像和视频生成任务中,在计算水平上表现出了相当大的性能改进。 我们的评价还直观地了解了所学到的路由机制,突出显示了国防部根据语义重要性和时间动态调整计算工作的能力。 因此,我们的工作为在耐久和受硬件限制的环境下解锁基因模型提供了一个步骤,并对传播模型内计算资源分配提供了深刻见解。

blocks.en:
While our work provides an extensive evaluation, it is ultimately limited by our computational resources, providing the opportunity for further evaluation with alternate datasets, architectures, and generative algorithms.
Namely, image generation datasets such as ArtBench ( Liao et al., 2022 ) and Food ( Bossard et al., 2014 ) , as well as video generation datasets such as Taichi-HD ( Siarohin et al., 2019 ) and Minecraft VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , would strengthen confidence in the performance of MoDDiT.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的工作提供了广泛的评价,但最终受到我们的计算资源的限制,从而提供了利用替代数据集、结构和基因算法进行进一步评价的机会。
即"Art Bench"(廖等,2022年)和"Food"(Bossard等,2014年)等图像生成数据集以及"Taichi-HD"(Siarohin等,2019年)和"Minecraft VPT"(Baker等,2022年)等视频生成数据集,会增强人们对MODDIT性能的信心.

blocks.en:
While MoDDiT can substantially reduce training and inference FLOPs, this reduction does not automatically translate into wall clock time savings.
Even though we observe throughput gains at larger batch sizes 1 1 1 At batch size 32, we measure 1.64 images/sec for a 50% MoDDiT model, vs. 1.55 images/sec for a DiT. , generating few images in parallel is slower.
This is likely due to a combination of the additional overhead of the gather and scatter operations, and the fact that dense matrix multiplication is already highly optimized itself.
Future work can explore the development of optimized kernels for sparse MoDDiT blocks, which have proven to lead to significant performance increases for attention blocks ( Dao, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
虽然国防部可以大大减少培训和推断FLOP,但这种减少并不能自动转化为墙钟时间的节省。
尽管我们观测到大批量的吞吐量增加 1 1 在批量尺寸32时,我们为50%的MODDIT模型测量1.64图像/秒,相对于1.55图像/秒的DiT.,生成少数平行图像的速度较慢.
这可能是由于集成和散开作业的额外间接费用,以及密集的矩阵乘法本身已经高度优化。
未来工作可以探索为稀疏的MODDiT区块开发优化内核,事实证明这会导致注意力区块的性能显著提升(Dao,2024.

blocks.en: Finally, MoDDiT introduces a capacity hyperparameter for the MLP and self-attention blocks, providing a range of promising avenues for further investigation. While our method avoids auxiliary losses, the addition of such a loss could enable automatic tuning of this capacity, with a regularization penalty against high compute budgets. Furthermore, we use the same capacity for both MLP and self-attention blocks. Visual inspection suggests that they have distinct allocation dynamics ( fig. 1 ), meaning their optimal capacities likely differ and should be investigated.
blocks.zh: 最后,反恐部引入了MLP和自觉区块的容量超参数,为进一步调查提供了一系列有希望的途径。 虽然我们的方法可以避免附带损失,但增加这种损失可以自动调整这种能力,同时对高计算预算实行正规化处罚。 此外,我们使用同样的容量来建造MLP和自留心区块。 视觉检查表明,它们有不同的分配动态(图1),这意味着它们的最佳能力可能不同,应当进行调查。

blocks.en: We use the 12.5 % 12.5\% -capacity DiT-L/2, block-replacement scheme and register count from section A.1 . The frozen Cosmos CV8x8x8 tokenizer ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) produces 64 × 64 × 16 64\times 64\times 16 latent frames. Each frame contains 1024 spatial tokens and eight state tokens in addition to the registers. We adopt spatiotemporal attention from ( Russell et al., 2025 ) , in which a token at a fixed spatial position and timestep attends to all tokens at the same timestep, and all tokens at the same spatial position in the past.
blocks.zh: 我们采用12.5%的12.5%的DiT-L/2能力、区块替换计划,并从A.1节登记计数。 被冷冻的宇宙 CV8x8x8 活化器(NVIDIA,2025)出产64×64×16 64\times 64\times 16个潜伏相框. 每个相框除登记外还包含有1024个空间活符和8个状态活符. 我们从(Russell等, 2025年)开始注意空间问题, 在一个固定空间位置和时间步的标志同时处理所有标志,

blocks.en: We train from scratch with seed 0, using the AdamW settings and weight EMA from section A.1 . Global batch sizes are 256 for ST-MoDDiT and 217 for ST-DiT. The learning rate warms up for 5,000 steps, then follows a cosine schedule towards 10 − 5 10^{-5} at 1M steps. Routing uses Gumbel-sigmoid temperature 5.
blocks.zh: 我们用0号种子从头开始训练,使用AdamW设置和A.1节的重量EMA. 全球分批尺寸为ST-MoDDIT为256个,ST-DIT为217个. 学习速度为5000个步骤取暖,然后按照一个同位素时间表,在1M步骤取向10 - 5 10 - 5 。 跑道使用甘贝尔-西格莫德温度 5.

blocks.en: We encode the first 17 frames, then autoregressively predict eight latents (64 frames), retaining three context latents and conditioning on the next eight recorded robot states. Sampling uses 128 DDPM steps per latent and the classifier-free guidance scale from section A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们编码了前17帧,然后自动预测出8个潜伏物(64帧),保留了3个上下文潜伏物,并在接下来的8个被记录下来的机器人状态上进行调制. 取样使用每个潜伏的128个DDPM步骤和A.1节的无分级制导尺度。

blocks.en: For table 1 , we evaluate both models’ EMA checkpoints at exactly 200,000 optimizer updates on 400 paired, non-overlapping 81-frame windows from 249 segments in one video from the raw validation v2.0 split. Clip identities and sampling seeds are shared across models. PSNR is computed against raw RGB frames at 0.5, 1 and 2 seconds after the observed context, averaging squared error across pixels and channels before conversion to dB. We report the clip-weighted mean and paired sparse-minus-dense gains. Pointwise 95% percentile confidence intervals use 20,000 paired bootstrap draws over segments, with seed 20261011, retaining all windows within each sampled segment. These intervals reflect evaluation variability, not training-seed variability. The temporal-change analysis in section B.2 uses its separately saved 300k, 100-clip cohort.
blocks.zh: 对于表1,我们评价两种型号的EMA检查站在400个对接的、非重叠的81个帧窗上进行20万个优化的更新,从原始验证v2.0分机的一盘录像中取出249个段。 剪切身份和取样种子在各种模式之间共享。 PSNR在观测到上下文后0.5,1和2秒时以原始RGB框架来计算,在转换为dB之前平均跨像素和通道的平方误差. 我们报告 剪接加权的平均值 和配对 稀有的微弱收益。 直指95%的置信间隔使用20,000对靴子拉出分段,种子为20261011,在每个被取样分段内保留所有窗口。 这些间隔反映了评价的可变性,而不是培训种子的可变性。 B.2节的时间变化分析使用了其单独节省的300k,100克的组分.

blocks.en: We count denoiser FLOPs over the first clip’s complete eight-latent rollout (128 DDPM calls per latent, CFG 1.5), including both guidance branches and all dense and routed blocks. Registered matrix, convolution and attention operations count a multiply-add as two FLOPs; tokenizer, scalar/nonlinear, normalization, selection and I/O work are excluded. The table reports total rollout TFLOPs, not per-call GFLOPs or measured throughput.
blocks.zh: 包括导线分支和所有密集和路由区块。 注册的矩阵、演化和注意操作将乘法加法算作两个FLOP;不包含标致剂、分级/非线性、正常化、选择和I/O工作。 该表报告总推出的TFLOP,而不是每个呼叫的GFLOP或测量的吞吐量.

blocks.en: B.2 Temporal change and allocation
blocks.zh: B.2 时间变化和分配

blocks.en: Using the setup in section B.1 , we measure temporal change by averaging absolute adjacent-frame grayscale differences over each latent’s temporal interval and spatial token footprint, including interval boundaries. For each spatial patch, allocation is the mean of its binary selection mask over attention and MLP branches, routed blocks, and denoising steps, expressed as a percentage. We use only the conditional guidance branch and exclude state/register tokens and dense blocks.
blocks.zh: 我们利用B.1节中的设置,通过在每种潜在时间间隔和空间标志脚印上,包括间隔界限上,平均绝对相邻框架的灰色尺度差异来测量时间变化。 对于每个空间补丁,分配是其二进制选择遮罩在注意力和MLP分支,路由区块和去诺步骤上的平均值,以百分比表示. 我们只使用有条件的指导分支,排除状态/注册符和密集块.

blocks.en: For fig. 5 , we clip frame differences at the global 99th percentile and group them into 100 equal-width bins. The line shows mean allocation; shading spans the within-bin 12.5th–87.5th percentiles, describing observed variation rather than uncertainty in the mean. Higher temporal change is associated with greater allocation, but frame difference is not optical flow, and this association does not establish a causal benefit from routing.
blocks.zh: 为了无花果. 5,我们把全球九分之九的相框差异 分成100个等宽的相框。 该行显示平均分配;阴影横跨第12.5至87.5百分位数,描述观察到的差异而不是平均值中的不确定性。 更高的时间变化与更大的分配相关,但帧相差不是光学流,而这种相相差并不确立由去向产生的因果关系.

blocks.en: Appendix C Self-Forcing adaptation
blocks.zh: 附录C 自强制适应

blocks.en: C.1 Sparse architecture and adaptation
blocks.zh: 页:1 Sparse 架构和适应

blocks.en: We follow the chunk-wise Self-Forcing DMD protocol ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , including its prompt data, optimization settings, and inference procedure, with the following sparse adaptation details.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循块形自强制DMD协议(Huang等,2025年),包括其即时数据,优化设置和推论程序,以下零星的适应细节.

blocks.en: Starting from the released ODE checkpoint, we keep every third block dense and add separate routers of hidden width 256 for self-attention queries and MLP tokens in the remaining blocks. Keys, values, and text cross-attention remain dense, and we use straight-through gates to keep the output magnitude of the pretrained model. Attention uses fixed-count selection; MLP selection is fixed-count for Funnel20 and threshold-based for Funnel50 ( section C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 从公布的ODE检查点开始,我们保持了三分之一的区块密集度,并添加了隐藏宽度256的单独路由器,用于在剩余区块中进行自觉查询和MLP令牌. 键,值,和文本的交叉意向仍然很密集,我们使用直通门来保持被预先训练的模型的输出量. 注意使用固定计数选择; MLP选择是Funnel20的固定计数,而Funnel50的阈值(C.1节.

blocks.en: We experiment with two MoDDiT models with capacity schedules we call Funnel20 and Funnel50 . Across the 30 blocks, target capacity decreases linearly from 100% at block 1 to 20% or 50% at block 30, respectively. Blocks 1, 4, 7, …, 28 override this schedule and remain fully dense. The names are chosen as the final-block targets, not the average model-wide capacity.
blocks.zh: 我们试验了两个MODDIT模型 并有容量表 我们称之为Funnel20和Funnel50。 在30个区块中,目标容量分别从第1区块的100%线性下降至第30区块的20%或50%。 1,4,7,28区 超过这个时间表 保持高度密集 名字被选为最后块目标,而不是整个模型的平均容量.

blocks.en: Initial qualitative experiments showed that increasing capacity in early blocks could recover structure that was otherwise lost under aggressive sparsity. We also retain dense keys and values, including cached context, so selected queries can attend to all available tokens, including tokens that receive no attention update.
blocks.zh: 初步的质量实验表明,早期区块容量的提高可以恢复本来在猛烈的痉挛下失去的结构。 我们还保留了密集的密钥和值,包括缓存上下文,因此所选择的查询可以处理所有可用的符号,包括得不到注意更新的符号.

blocks.en: We jointly adapt the student and routers for 3,000 ODE updates, reducing capacity to the target with a cosine schedule over the first 600 updates. Trajectories use 48 sampling steps and guidance scale 6, retaining five states each. We then run 25 critic warmup iterations and 1,000 DMD iterations, starting student EMA at iteration 200.
blocks.zh: 我们联合调整了学生和路由器,用于3000个ODE更新,在前600个更新中以同位素时间表来降低对目标的能力. 轨迹采用48个采样步骤和6号制导尺度,各保留5个状态. 然后我们运行了25个评论家热身和1000个DMD热身,从学生EMA热身200开始.

blocks.en: We compare the final student EMA with the released dense EMA checkpoint from Self Forcing. VBench and compute protocols are in section C.2 ; qualitative comparisons are in section C.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了最后的学生EMA和Self Forcing释放的密集EMA检查站. V Bench和计算协议载于C.2节;质量比较载于C.3节。

blocks.en: C.2 VBench evaluation and compute accounting
blocks.zh: C.2 V 本奇评价和计算会计

blocks.en: We evaluate the released dense Self-Forcing EMA checkpoint and the Funnel50/Funnel20 EMA checkpoints after 1,000 DMD iterations using the sampling settings in section C.1 . We use the original English VBench prompts ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , with five samples per prompt and reproducible seeds derived from the prompt and sample index. We apply the official category normalization and weights, and the total score weights quality and semantic scores 4:1. The separate motion and instruction scores in fig. 6 use 100 Causal-Forcing motion prompts, one sample each: motion is the percentage classified as dynamic, and instruction following is 100 times the mean VisionReward yes/no judgment, encoded as 1 or − 1 -1 .
blocks.zh: 我们利用C.1节中的取样设置,评估了在经过1,000个DMD重复后释放的密集的自我强制EMA检查站和Funnel50/Funnel20EM检查站。 我们使用原始的英语V Bench points(Huang等,2023年),每个即时和可再生的种子有5个样本取自即时和样本指数. 我们实行正式类别正常化和权重,总分分分数分质量和语义分数为4:1. 单独的动作和指令分数为无花果. 6使用100个Causal-Forcing运动提示,每个样本一个:运动是被归类为动态的百分数,下面的指示是平均Vision Reward yes/no 判断的100倍,编码为1或− 1-1.

blocks.en: Table 3 gives the category scores and aggregates. Relative to dense Self-Forcing, Funnel50 and Funnel20 reduce the total score by 4.93% and 5.35%, respectively, while decreasing inference FLOPs by 16.8% and 24.0%. Both lose more on multiple objects and spatial relationships than on imaging quality. This could be because they concentrate compute on a single part of the image, not capturing relationships between different image parts.
blocks.zh: 表3列出类别分数和总数。 相对于密集自强制,Funnel50和Funnel20分别将总分减少4.93%和5.35%,而推断FLOP则减少16.8%和24.0%. 两者在多物体和空间关系上的损失都大于成像质量. 这可能是因为他们集中计算图像的一部份,而不是捕捉不同图像部分之间的关系.

blocks.en: Table 3: VBench scores for dense Self-Forcing and percentage-point changes for sparse EMA models relative to it (positive is better). Category scores are raw values multiplied by 100; aggregates use official normalization and weighting. Deltas are computed before rounding; categories are ordered by the Funnel20 point reduction, largest first. The final row gives absolute transformer TFLOPs for the matched clip described below (lower is better).
blocks.zh: 表3:V Bench对密集自强的分数和相对其而言的稀有EMA模型的百分比变化(正数较好). 类别分数为生值乘以100;汇总采用官能化和权重. 三角洲在四舍五入前计算;类别由Funnel20分还原法(Funnel20 point reduction)订购,排行第一。 最后一行给出了以下描述的匹配剪辑的绝对变压器TFLOP(下行更好).

blocks.en: We count matrix-operation FLOPs for one matched 81-frame raccoon-guitar clip at 832 × 480 832\times 480 , seed 0 and batch size 1, including 28 denoising calls and six KV-cache updates. A multiply-add counts as two FLOPs. Dense Self-Forcing and Funnel20 use runtime operator shapes; Funnel50 uses recorded query and realized MLP token counts. Transformer costs are 950.39, 789.93 and 722.53 TFLOPs for dense, Funnel50 and Funnel20, giving reductions of 16.88% and 23.98%. Adding the shared text-encoder and VAE matrix/convolution cost of 289.39 TFLOPs reduces these savings to 12.94% and 18.38%. Counts exclude scalar/nonlinear operations, indexing, memory transfers and hardware padding. They describe arithmetic for this clip, not benchmark-wide averages or measured speedups; dynamic MLP allocation varies with the input.
blocks.zh: 我们计算一个匹配的81帧浣熊-吉他剪辑的矩阵操作FLOP,时间为832 × 480 832\tims 480,种子0和批量尺寸为1,包括28个去诺调用和6个KV-cache更新. 加乘法算作两个FLOP. Dense Self-Forcing and Funnel20使用运行时操作器形状;Funnel50使用已记录的查询并实现的MLP令牌计数. 变压器成本为950.39,789.93和722.53TFLOP,用于密度,漏斗50和漏斗20,减少了16.88%和23.98%. 加上289.39个TFLOP的共享文本编码器和VAE矩阵/编组成本,这些节余将降至12.94%和18.38%。 计数排除了scalar/nonlinear操作,索引,内存传输和硬件地标. 它们描述的是这个片段的算术,而不是全基准平均值或被测量的速度;动态的MLP分配随输入而有差异.
